snippet.title: Ashes: Epoch Teaser Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Ashes - Epoch is a standalone campaign mod the GZDoom game Ashes - Afterglow.
Stepping into the shoes of a new scavenger: Shepherd.
Set in the years prior to the events of Afterglow, Shepherd explores the city of Denver, from the windy roofs of ruined buildings, down to the dark tunnels of the Metro system - Epoch intends to remain faithful to the Ashes episodes you know and love, whilst introducing new mechanics and features to spice things up.
Credits:
Roobly, Vostyok, Pato Fanático, Balls24, Oriol Deimos, Cain.Protocol.
